title: Kaizen subagent frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block in plugins/kaizen/agents/<name>.md files. Validates the parsed frontmatter (not the raw YAML text). Loader normalizes tools / disallowedTools from any supported surface form (JSON array, YAML list, comma-separated string) to a list[str] before validation.

name.description: Agent's slug — must equal the filename stem and start with `kaizen-`.

description.description: Routing surface for skill-suggest and the Agent dispatcher. Must clearly state WHEN to use this agent and include 2+ trigger phrases or example dispatches.

tools.description: Whitelist of allowed tools. Each entry is either a bare tool name (Read, Bash, Edit) OR a pattern-restricted Bash invocation like `Bash(git diff *)`.

disallowedTools.description: Patterns explicitly denied even when the matching tool is in `tools`. Use to block destructive ops for autonomous agents (git reset *, git push *, rm -rf *, etc.).

model.description: Model to use. `inherit` follows the dispatching agent. Explicit choice locks the agent to that tier.

color.description: Optional UI color (cyan, green, blue, etc.).

maxTurns.description: Hard cap on agent turns. Forces self-termination.

context.description: `fork` = clean context with only the dispatch prompt; `inherit` = receives dispatcher's recent context.

skills.description: Skills to auto-load when this agent starts. Format: `<plugin>:<skill>` or bare `<skill>`.

ToolSpec.description: Either a bare tool name (`Read`, `Bash`, `Edit`) OR a Bash pattern (`Bash(git diff *)`, `Bash(python *)`). The Claude Code dispatcher matches the literal Bash invocation against the parenthesized pattern.
